title: RecordVersion
description: pcs.v2 immutable Record version (J.2). Published versions are not edited in place; privacy deletion is the explicit exception handled by the state layer. A plain state_revision field is not part of this envelope: the commit revision is committed_state_revision. Per-kind body schemas are future work; this contract fixes only the shared shape.

kind.description: Record kind. The set is open here because per-kind body schemas arrive with later cards (007+).

schema_version.description: Body schema version label for this kind.

status.description: Record status. J.2 does not enumerate the values, so the contract does not invent an enum.

body.description: Kind-specific body. Strict per-kind validation is out of scope for PCS2-002.

source_refs.description: Exact source references for this version.
